reason: The hypothesis restates the central finding of P4/P7/P9/P14/P21—that LCO roughens the dislocation energy landscape, raises activation barriers, and increases strength—as a prediction, and proposes the same intervention (annealing to vary LCO) on the same model alloy (NiCoCr) already studied in those passages. The mechanism is taken word for word from those passages, and the predicted outcomes on strength and deformation patterns are already reported there. The falsification test is a straightforward application of the same idea and does not resolve any conflict or gap.

LCO raises activation barriers to dislocation glide
LCO alters deformation pathways (planar slip, twinning)
LCO reduced by severe plastic deformation
